description:
Beautiful Unofficial YouTube Music desktop app that includes several customizations for users and developers.

Unofficial YouTube Music desktop client for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Features Discord Rich Presence, custom themes, Last.fm scrobbling, tray view,
Stream Deck support, local API, OBS overlays, and ytmd:// shared links.
